export_format: C-CDA (Summary of Care Record, ZIP archive)

export_mechanisms.name: Single Patient Export
export_mechanisms.path: Lookup Medical Records → Patient → Clinical Document → Summary of Care Records → Generate → Download ZIP

export_mechanisms.name: Multiple Patient Export
export_mechanisms.path: EMR Reports → Export Patient Medical Records → Select patients → Generate ZIP
export_mechanisms.scope: Bulk C-CDA for selected or all patients

export_mechanisms.name: Patient Portal Export
export_mechanisms.path: Patient Portal → View Health Information → Summary of Care Records → Download ZIP
export_mechanisms.scope: Single patient C-CDA via patient-facing portal

coverage_assessment.notes: Export is a standard C-CDA Summary of Care with no vendor-specific documentation. C-CDA would include standard clinical sections (demographics, problems, meds, allergies, vitals, labs, immunizations, procedures, notes) but no billing, scheduling, insurance details, communications, or practice management data. Without a data dictionary or sample data, exact coverage cannot be verified.
